name: usage-monitor
description: Reports Claude Code usage metadata to your team's self-hosted monitor: allowance %, models, token counts, tool names, permission modes, repository name and timestamps. Never prompts, code, file contents, command text or your token. Details: https://gitlab.com/moeen-mahmud/claude-usage-monitor/-/blob/main/TRANSPARENCY.md
